hypothesis: With fits_when predicates and bindings, query-patterns-inline can inject the right mini-patterns into any write-time context cross-language, and qualifier graduation can cite manifest-diff lift instead of vibes.
summary: Pattern-library entries today carry generalizability qualifiers but not applicability machinery. Proposal: each pattern splits into (a) the semantic invariant (declare recurring cross-cutting behavior, do not inline it), (b) a bindings table mapping ecosystems to idioms (Python decorator, TS HOF/decorator, Rust attribute macro, Django middleware/DRF permission class), (c) fits_when predicates keyed to the adapter.yml marker vocabulary so retrieval at write/plan time is mechanical, and (d) first-class counter-indications so patterns are not applied where forces do not hold. Mirrors the ADR 0036 architecture one level up: manifest is to detection shims as invariant is to application bindings.
title: Mini-patterns stored as language-agnostic invariant plus per-ecosystem binding table with machine-checkable fits-when predicates

summary: The detector fleet finds negative space (duplication, drift, smells); the mass-findings rule already escalates >=5 similar findings into one standardize-and-enforce candidate. The missing third extraction source is positive mining: detect recurring solution shapes that demonstrably work (the same guard idiom at N sites, an exemplary commenting density band, a decorator used consistently in one subsystem but absent in its siblings) and propose them as pattern intakes. Deterministic scripts find structural candidates cheaply; cheap-model judges classify pattern fit per the ADR 0036 judge-stage precedent, since is-this-an-instance-of-X is where AST rules are brittle and models are strong.
title: Mine the positive space: extract candidate mini-patterns from recurring successful shapes, not just recurring failures

hypothesis: Composition search becomes tractable because operator cards prune the combinatorial space and the ledger accumulates dominance evidence per context; cross-domain validity (writing and code) would confirm the coordination kernel generalizes beyond engineering.
summary: The content project's experiment registry empirically demonstrates that quality-enhancement operators (panel-guided revision, self-premortem, reflection lenses) are non-additive: revision helps only when the diagnosed blocker aligns, self-premortem creates flaws it is blind to, lens diversity raises ceiling AND variance with the protect-lens veto as the safety mechanism. Proposal: encode each enhancement as an operator card (precondition = blocker types, expected effect, variance profile, known negative interactions, required guard pairing); record every composition run as (context, operator stack, measured delta vs baseline) in a composition ledger; route via a controller that diagnoses the blocker first and selects the operator whose lift profile matches - the ADR 0031 next-necessary-step doctrine generalized. Pipelines become compiled special cases of the policy.
title: Operator cards plus a composition ledger: typed enhancement operators with measured interaction effects and a route-by-blocker controller

summary: Correction from the operator (2026-06-12): avatar predictive validity against humans is proven within reason - reader agents produced similar responses on obfuscated patterns to the documented human reception of the specific movies those patterns came from; content-project docs are stale on this. The binding limitations are instead two generalizable LLM deficits: (1) lens adherence - an LLM judges from the prompted lens and does not auto-switch lenses the way humans do when understanding/judging; (2) no cumulative mental-model building - causal relationships and emotional impact get dropped as input streams in unless state-tracking is explicitly demanded.

hypothesis: A reader agent forced to maintain a beat-by-beat causal/emotional state journal will recognize dropped causal links and emotional payoffs that a single-pass reader misses; testable as a content-project experiment with the existing pairwise instrument.
summary: Generalizable failure modes observed in reader-agent work and equally present in code judgment: (1) an LLM evaluates from the lens it was given rather than fluidly switching lenses as humans do, and (2) it does not consolidate a running causal/emotional model as input accumulates unless explicitly instructed. Both repos already compensate by externalization without naming the principle: the detector fleet and avatar panels instantiate lenses as separate passes composed externally (do not ask one model to switch lenses), and manifests, ledgers, scout extracted-behaviors files, and projections act as external state the model cannot be trusted to maintain internally. Design rules: lens coverage is a perimeter question (a find-perimeter-gaps analog for judgment dimensions), and any build-the-model-as-you-go requirement must be externalized into an explicit incremental artifact.
title: Two generalizable LLM judgment deficits - lens adherence and no cumulative mental model - and externalization as the compensation pattern

summary: TOC applied to quality systems: progress comes from finding the binding constraint, which requires a definition of better-system-state. Both repos independently rediscovered TOC fragments - revise-only-when-blocker-aligns (content registry) and converge/ADR-0031 weakest-necessary-node routing (engineering) - but neither has the goal side explicit. Proposal: goals are composed, not scalar - a target value function (segment-specific, per the critic-vs-audience and PMF polarization findings), floor constraints on non-target dimensions (the protect lens generalized), and a veto set; the goal adapts as lifecycle thresholds are crossed (ADR 0020 / project-lifecycle-stage-core). Constraint identification must be allowed to land on the meta level: in both projects the current binding constraint was the instrument or process (avatar dynamic range, orchestrator context), not the artifact - TOC policy constraints.
title: Theory-of-Constraints routing over a composable goal definition: target value function plus floor constraints plus veto set

hypothesis: A lens battery with explicit placement and compatibility metadata produces more usable insight per token than ad-hoc single-lens prompting, and the triage-then-deep-follow-up shape recovers most of human lens-switching at a fraction of the cost of full parallel fan-out.
summary: Extends the lens-perimeter audit from coverage (which lenses exist) to deployment (where in the process each lens produces usable lift, which lenses can be merged into one pass because they are not opposed, which must run independently). Each lens declares: judgment dimension, stage placement, cost tier, output contract (some dimensions answer correctly in a few tokens; others need surfaced structure first), correlation/compatibility with sibling lenses, and a falsifiable value-add claim checkable against effectiveness telemetry. Includes the cached-battery execution shape: sequential same-context micro-questions exploit prompt caching for cheap multi-dimensional triage, with the known trade-off that later lenses see earlier answers (anchoring/correlation) - so verdict-critical lenses run independent-parallel while triage lenses run cached-sequential.
title: Lens cards: per-lens metadata for stage placement, cost tier, output contract, compatibility, and declared value-add

summary: Lenses cover understanding; capabilities cover execution. The ecosystem assumes execution capability comes from the LLM, but the right tool converts hard-or-expensive agent work into easy deterministic work (ADR 0036 is the exemplar: detection moved from agent loops to scripts). Proposal: make what-would-make-this-easy a standing bias - mine effectiveness/skill-use telemetry for recurring high-token agent task shapes and surface them as tool candidates, the capability-side analog of the lens-perimeter audit.
title: Tool-bias as a kernel value: detect capability gaps where deterministic tooling would make hard agent work easy

summary: Goal-triple extensions surfaced 2026-06-12: the target/floors/veto definition is missing (1) a horizon - value measured as trajectory vs immediate state (the ratchet is a trajectory goal); (2) a risk posture - whether ceiling+variance operators are good depends on slate vs single-shot tolerance; (3) cost/budget terms - constraint elevation must be priceable or TOC routing cannot compare options; (4) an information-gain term - retracted experiments banked value as knowledge, and a pure-exploit goal definition kills learning. Also open: goal arbitration when stakeholder value functions conflict (critic vs audience is the live example).

Strengthened 2026-06-12: the routing/discoverability discussion (bootstrap problem - nothing routes users to the router) makes naming-as-routing the core rationale. Skill names and folder structure are the zero-cost router that works before any meta-skill is invoked; reorganization should optimize for a user looking at the tree and knowing what to use and when. Note: concept renaming itself is /rename-concept - the operator could not recall which skill does it, which is itself evidence for this entry.

lesson_body: Any project is a composition of work pipelines built on a set of ideas for creating value or blocking problems. Raising the bar of all software produced therefore depends less on discovering new ideas than on grasping the correct use of known ones: which idea, applied where, toward what defined value. The card-schema chain (pattern cards with fit predicates, operator cards with interaction effects, lens cards with placement/compatibility, composable goals with TOC constraint routing) is the machinery that converts idea-understanding into reliable idea-application. The content project served as the second domain witness that this structure generalizes beyond code.
lesson_title: Projects are compositions of ideas; the kernel's meta-capability is making idea-application legible and routable

summary: Concrete taxonomy proposal 2026-06-12: a capabilities folder with verb-noun hierarchy, e.g. capabilities/rename/ containing rename-files, rename-concepts - the folder answers what-can-I-do, the leaf answers to-what, since a bare rename skill would be ambiguous. Constraint: build on ADR 0034 skill-namespace-layering. Rationale refinement: the gain is primarily human intuitiveness (LLMs lean on which-* routers and frontmatter), so design and justify it as product surface work given the product direction.

Selective mid-task forgetting means building a fresh context with only the relevant pieces. Its three costs - relevance judgment, many contexts per goal, and lost input caching - resolve cleanly against cache mechanics: the prompt cache TTL (~5 min) means phase boundaries lose the cache anyway, so they are free reconstruction points. Rule: rebuild minimal context at converge gates (the gate verdict - strongest/weakest nodes, next necessary step - is the curated seed for the next context), keep cached-append within a phase. ADR 0036 packets are the proven special case: planner judges relevance from digests, executor receives a reconstructed minimal context.
title: Reconstruct context at phase boundaries where the cache is already lost; append within phases

summary: Summary-pyramid L3 finding (reports/summary-pyramid/scan-20260612-115132): ~10 find-*-drift skills are one machine pointed at different surfaces - declare a canonical source (glossary, ADR, contract, route table, frontmatter), compare against reality, emit banded mismatches. find-contract-drift already importing find-frontend-contract-drift's detector is the consolidation pressure made visible. Proposal: a shared drift-scan contract in scripts/_lib/ plus drift-doctrine.md, so adding a drift surface costs a config entry, not a whole skill. Natural W-item for the shareable-core-reorganization plan.
title: Extract the shared drift-scan framework: canonical source + comparison bands + evidence schema; new surfaces become configs, not skills

summary: Summary-pyramid L3 (scan-20260612-115132) supplies the emergent grouping the reorg should encode: seven real subsystems (drift-sensor array, self-governance immune system, implicit-to-explicit lifters, two-executor funnel, memory hierarchy, planning spine, dispatch layer) plus a host-specific /sites shadow cluster to quarantine per the portability roadmap. Specific recs: skills/drift/ grouping, a named ecosystem-self-audit tier with one meta-audit entry point, one duplication entry point with lenses, execution-funnel.md doctrine for the two-writer authorization architecture, a memory map decision table for the seven knowledge stores, and crisp numeric Feature-vs-System tier triggers. CAUTION on the dispatcher-consolidation rec: ADR 0023 deliberately separated which-cleanup (diff-scoped) from which-shape/which-skill (forward) - the pyramid could not see that reasoning; judge before merging. Also the orphan list is partly wrong (orient is the ADR 0020 pull mechanism).

The kit at ~/Projects/experiments/claude-instructions/meta-failure-audit-kit (meta-audit SKILL.md, LENS-CHECKLIST.md, fan-out workflow) audits reasoning and measurement failures - falsifiability-of-setup, inference discipline, construct validity, honest self-account, instrument-is-object reflexivity, audit-the-evaluation, plus a novel critic. Only its stance and signal-not-verdict vocabulary migrated (into gut-check); the lens machinery did not. It is the immune system's missing organ: existing self-governance skills audit ARTIFACT integrity (references, counts, frontmatter); nothing audits REASONING/frames. Its lens 1 (inherited-frame) and lens 5 (instrument-is-object) precisely name why self-scans missed the catalog reorganization findings.
title: Port /meta-audit (six-lens disinterested meta-failure audit) from meta-failure-audit-kit into the ecosystem

summary: The one-off workflow (reports/summary-pyramid/scan-20260612-115132; 94 components, 23 agents, ~826k tokens, 4 min) surfaced emergent subsystems, implicit goals, and consolidation pressure that two years of bottom-up detector self-runs never found. Key design invariants to preserve: L2 chunks must be arbitrary (alphabetical) so clusters emerge at L3 instead of being smuggled in; L1/L2 on cheap models, L3 on a strong model; explicit license to report sprawl. It is the externalized build-the-global-model operation the detector fleet constitutionally lacks - the holistic frame-breaking complement to local pattern matchers. Candidate cadence: after major catalog changes or quarterly.
title: Promote the summary pyramid (L1 per-file, L2 arbitrary-chunk, L3 synthesis) to a standing MAP-tier skill

lesson_body: A detector fleet of local bottom-up pattern matchers, plus a consistency checker that verifies the catalog against its own declared taxonomy, can never discover that the taxonomy itself is the wrong frame - the instrument is the object (meta-audit lens 5) and the frame is inherited (lens 1). Evidence: 9 logged self-runs of individual detectors found zero catalog-level findings; one summary pyramid that deliberately discarded the official taxonomy found seven emergent subsystems, five implicit goals, and a dozen consolidation candidates in 4 minutes. Apply by pairing every self-governance suite with a periodic holistic pass that is structurally forbidden from using the system's own categories.
lesson_title: Self-consistency checkers cannot find frame errors; schedule frame-breaking holistic passes

summary: No skill owns the question what is this project trying to become and are we converging - /converge is per-phase, /orient is lifecycle classification, /project-interview is intent capture, target-architecture-artifact is the code-shape special case. Gap named 2026-06-12: even odds that plans never fully execute and the project never reaches coherent refined form, because nothing watches goal-level convergence. Proposal: a small composable goal artifact (target value function + floor constraints + veto set + horizon, per composable-goal-constraint-router) plus a drift check; cheapest first embodiment is a goals section in status.json so the dashboard renders stated-goal-vs-trajectory. The TOC constraint router then has its goal side.
title: A /goal layer: standing project-goal artifact with convergence drift check

summary: Kit-gap analysis complete (reports/meta-audit-kit-gaps/analysis.md): the six lenses audit the artifact as a closed text; four structural gaps are all artifact-vs-outside relations - lens 7 goal-validity/decision-relevance, lens 8 actuation/signal-consumption (strongest; the kit's README confesses it about itself), lens 9 temporal validity/decay, lens 10 perimeter/negative-space (which the quote-anchoring rule structurally cannot see - artifacts can pass by omission alone). Also: three cross-lens duplicate pairs collapse the six to ~3 root concerns; fix is boundary hygiene, not merging. The port should ship 10 lenses. Live validation: lens 8 IS the failure mode the adversarial review caught in the execution plan (enforcement asserted, never validated against code), and the dogfooded six-lens review caught it - while lens 8 names why the kit could not have guaranteed anyone would act on the catch.

The toolkit has detectors, routers, and a debt queue but no declared policy for WHEN scans run on a host project and HOW findings are prioritized into work. Proposal: cadence derives from the orient grid (ADR 0020) - prototype/internal runs on-demand at closeout (which-cleanup), production/external earns scheduled sweeps and ratchet-as-CI-gate; the zero-token detection tier (ADR 0036) makes per-commit manifests affordable at any tier. Prioritization stacks: triage-debt recurrence scoring, importance-map weighting (ADR 0016), then the goal layer routes to the binding constraint (composable-goal-constraint-router) - delivered through the status projection so the dashboard renders next-most-valuable, not just newest. Open question: where the policy lives (adapter.yml field vs project-state.json vs its own ADR).
title: Cadence and prioritization policy for host projects: stakes-gated scan rhythm, goal-routed priority

summary: Operator direction 2026-06-12: W-F closes via clean-room rebuild, not retrofit. comic/content folders become a read-only evidence corpus (assets stay put); operators harvested into cards + dead-end autopsies; a fresh greenfield project (ecosystem installed from commit zero, goal artifact instantiated, first slice proves the core output path) adopts them by composition with recorded adoption events. Also the dogfood venue for Track A's projection. New folder name/location TBD.

Clean-room rebuild target named: ~/Projects/content-pipeline (operator direction 2026-06-12). Phase 1 harvest reads ~/Projects/comic and ~/Projects/content as read-only corpus; Phase 2 greenfield setup installs the ecosystem from commit zero with status projection + goal artifact + queue.

Git history rewritten 2026-06-12 (git-filter-repo): inspiration-source real names replaced by codenames in all commit messages, blobs, and filenames across 139 commits / 4 branches; force-pushed to origin. Commit shas recorded in ledger events before this note refer to the pre-rewrite history; the W-A entry in ai-docs/plans/consistency-session-execution.md carries the post-rewrite equivalents. Backup mirror: /tmp/engineering-skills-pre-rewrite.git (temporary).

adoption_evidence: ~/Projects/content-pipeline commit a96923a — clean-room rebuild commit zero: ai-docs/harvest/{comic,content}-corpus.md (verbatim scout reports), ai-docs/operators/README.md (19-operator index + dead-end autopsies), fresh ledger seeded with all 19 operators and composes-with edges, build rule 'copy only via operator card + recorded adoption event'. W-F harvest-output linkage; full W-F closure still awaits the first in-project code adoption.

summary: Installing the ecosystem into a new host (content-pipeline, 2026-06-12) required a hand-curated copy: git ls-files minus ~15 exclusion patterns (host-local state, reports, ledger, ES-specific plans), fresh .engineering/manifest.json, venv build, pre-commit install, then instantiating .engineering/project-state.json and docs/importance-map.md because ADR 0016/0021 applies_to link-checks fail without them. Every step is mechanizable. Success: scripts/install_pack.py <target> (or equivalent) produces a green-test, green-hook host in one command, with the exclusion list maintained in one place instead of in a session transcript.
title: One-command installer for the portable pack

summary: A sweep asking which documented claims have no implementation, which proven findings were never wired into the pipeline, and which retracted caveats still appear in docs. /find-orphaned-ideas covers ideas and /find-skill-intent-drift covers skills; nothing audits knowledge-to-usage drift. Validated in the Talos-adjacent corpora: a rediscovery audit there found 23 unwired findings. Candidate find-* skill via /plan-skill.
title: Knowledge-to-usage drift audit: proven findings nothing reads

summary: Adversarial-review lanes, /gut-check, and skill-effectiveness telemetry assume LLM judgment is valid without testing it. The corpus-proven counter: a cheap no-baseline-persona control reveals whether a judge predicts or merely recalls (it killed a corpus instrument's predictive claims at bare-model r~0.96 via memorization). Toolkit shape: a documented control-run convention, or a harness step, for any skill whose verdicts steer decisions.
title: Leakage gate for the toolkit's own LLM-judgment surfaces

summary: ADRs record decisions but not dissenting views or disagree-and-commit instructions; revisit_when exists but dissent does not. The corpus decision-ledger protocol locks decisions with authority basis, rejected alternatives, dissent, and recheck conditions. Candidate: optional dissent field in the ADR schema + decisions.py awareness. Cheap; mostly a template + audit change.
title: ADR frontmatter: first-class dissent and recheck-trigger fields

summary: The five capture tiers record rules, case law, and operational gotchas — all output-shaped. None names biases in the agent's own working method (e.g. defaulting to text-spec iteration on a visual problem). Corpus method-slip logs proved this a distinct, valuable entry kind. Cheapest landing: a documented entry convention in the task-diary tier, not a sixth surface.
title: Method-slip entries in the learning-capture system

summary: The map-suspect-explain-refactor-guard loop installs guards via /prevent-regression but nothing ever audits them: which fired and were load-bearing, which false-alarmed, which missed regressions they claimed to cover. GUARD has no feedback edge — guards accrete forever. Corpus-proven counter (Talos-adjacent corpora): per-run gate postmortems with note budgets (2-4 hard gates, max 3 blocking notes). Candidate skill or a periodic mode of an existing find-* skill; data sources are lint-hit history and effectiveness.jsonl.
title: Guard postmortem: audit whether installed guards earn their keep

summary: effectiveness.jsonl records findings and outcomes; nothing records token spend, rate-limit pressure, or context-budget headroom for skill runs and sub-agent fan-outs. The corpora ship working per-call token tracking, x-ratelimit-* bucket monitoring, cost ledgers keyed by owner/process/model, and escalating context-budget thresholds (warn 50, pressure 60, block 75). Relevant to cross-tool-agent-governance's parallel context budgeting policy, which is currently prose without measurement.
title: Spend telemetry: the toolkit tracks findings, never cost

summary: Project noqa markers carry a reason today, but nothing carries residual risk, a recheck trigger, or an expiry — suppressions are permanent the moment they land. Corpus pattern (wrongness permission slip): intentional gate violation as a first-class artifact with approval and recheck condition. Cheapest landing: extend the noqa convention to support an until/recheck token + a sweep that flags expired suppressions.
title: Lint suppressions carry rationale, recheck trigger, and expiry

summary: Composing corpus finding (third sweep): fake-yes detection — soft positive judge verdicts are not accepted without a behavioral correlate (plausible recipient, pitch, shared element). The leakage gate tests whether a judge predicts rather than recalls; the behavioral probe tests whether a yes is load-bearing. Both belong in any toolkit judge-validity convention.

All extraction surfaces (/extract-existing-ideas, harvest scouts, comparison sweeps) read text; ideas also live in generated artifacts themselves — images, audio, rendered output — with their own applicability context. Operator-observed during the content-pipeline harvest: three text sweeps missed the visual axis entirely; a pixel-grounded probe found six proven operators. Working method from that probe: metadata-first (corpora often extract visual lessons into adjacent text — READMEs, strategy docs, prompt notes), then bounded artifact sampling to confirm/refute, then stage the expensive full inventory as a queue packet with a vision-capable executor (own session or delegated, e.g. Codex). Candidate: a modality checklist in the harvest/sweep doctrine, not necessarily a new skill.
title: Idea extraction must cover non-text artifact modalities

lesson_body: Process bias observed live (2026-06-12, the session that intaken this very idea): repeated reach for bash idioms in a zsh shell — unquoted $VAR expecting word-splitting, '===' as an echo separator, conditional-flag expansion inside helper functions — produced an errors-upon-errors trail the operator noticed, even though every failure was caught and state stayed clean. Rule: in zsh, never rely on word-splitting (use explicit branches or arrays), never use bare '===' as a separator, and dry-run a batch helper function once before fanning it out over 19 calls. The slip class is method, not output: the commits were all correct.
lesson_title: Bash-isms in a zsh harness produce visible error cascades

summary: Corpus-proven gap (fourth comparison sweep): accidentally-good material inside failed or rejected outputs has no capture surface — the ledger records deliberate intakes, lessons record rules, but nothing harvests what failure produced for free. The corpus pattern promotes salvage through explicit states (discarded, parked, audition, soft-canon, hard-canon). Cheapest landing: a harvest-time prompt in the sweep-before-ending rule plus a salvaged-from origin tag, not a new tier.
title: Idea ledger captures deliberate ideas, never the by-products of failure

summary: sub-agents.md and cross-tool-agent-governance.md set context-budget policy by convention; the corpus ran T1-T5 context-dose ablations and got measured answers (framing alone drives tone, named vocabulary drives on-brand invention, full detail trades creativity for control). Toolkit version: a small ablation protocol for scout/reviewer briefs — which brief tier changes finding quality — feeding the parallel context budgeting policy with data. Composes with spend-telemetry (cost side of the same question).
title: Measure sub-agent context dosing instead of treating it by convention

summary: The content-pipeline harvest needed four operator-driven external sweeps to find what one disciplined pass should have: the initial brief framed a single (production) ontology, the loop stopped after one round, and later sweeps wasted tokens re-finding captured items. Fix in the extraction surfaces (/extract-existing-ideas, harvest scout briefs, comparison sweeps): (1) declared axis list — production, measurement/epistemics, agent-runtime, economics, artifact modality; (2) loop-until-dry termination — two consecutive re-find-only rounds; (3) mandatory diff against the idea ledger and operator index before reporting; (4) a completeness-critic pass (which axis was not run, which source unread). All four already exist as orchestration doctrine; this intake is about installing them into the skill layer so the operator stops being the completeness critic by hand.
title: Harvest briefs declare axes, loop until dry, and diff against the ledger

summary: The corpus-comparison misses cluster into one categorical gap, not scattered features: nothing in the ecosystem instruments whether judgment is valid — LLM-judge verdicts, review-lane findings, skill-effectiveness outcomes, and craft rules are all recorded as conclusions with no evidence state. Fragments already intaken: llm-judge-leakage-gate, guard-false-alarm-accounting, spend-telemetry, context-dose-measurement; the claim-trust-registry exemplar lives in the corpus. This intake names the cluster so it can be designed as one doctrine area (a sixth concern beside the five capture tiers: claims carry trust states — banked / directional / retracted / open — and judges carry validity evidence) instead of landing as disconnected features. Extraction corollary: a toolkit can only harvest what its ontology names, so this layer also widens future harvests.
title: Validity layer: the toolkit guards code quality but trusts judgment uninstrumented

summary: From the corpus GPT 5.5 Pro dialogue: promotion standard for any process stage, gate, or intermediate artifact — not did it produce nice diagnostics, not did the score improve, but did the artifact get worse when the stage was ablated. Counters process decoration (note-piles, contract-shaped obedience, bureaucratic scoring). Composes with guard-false-alarm-accounting: that audits installed guards retrospectively; this gates new stages prospectively. Applies to this toolkit's own skill pipeline stages as much as to content pipelines.
title: A pipeline stage is useful only if removing it visibly worsens output

summary: The corpus dialogue's strongest critique of its own harness: the same provider drafted, diagnosed, repaired, reader-reported, and scorecarded — rewarding self-consistency over truth (validators checked contract EXISTENCE, not contract TRUTH). The architecture that fixes it: independent extractors, a reconciler with confidence labels, a generator that consumes, a verifier that checks against the reconciled artifact (never the generator's own ledger), and a cost auditor asking whether obedience helped. Toolkit relevance: review lanes, /converge verdicts, and any skill where one agent both produces and validates. Preserve-disagreement corollary: multi-lens outputs are never averaged into one score.
title: Role separation in agent harnesses: no model grades its own paperwork

summary: Corpus-proven gate (fifth comparison sweep, ~/Projects/comic consolidation doc 98): when execution discovers something better than the plan, the revision routes to the spec while protecting what consumers already attached to in the delivered artifact. Our chain freezes plan sections at architected and /refactor-subsystem executes the spec, but no rule says what happens when implementation legitimately diverges upward — today that is silent drift or ad-hoc judgment. Candidate: a divergence-routing rule in plan-spec/refactor-subsystem doctrine (spec amendment + consumer-protection check), composing with hold-function-flex-spec vocabulary (what must hold vs what may flex).
title: Plans/specs workflow lacks a rule for execution finding a better answer

summary: Two corpus primitives, one mechanism: open promises decay on explicit patience budgets (opened_on, urgency, patience_remaining — ~/Projects/comic ghost-structures/v6/mystery-ledger.md) and parked branches carry wake-up criteria naming what reactivates them (~/Projects/comic AGENTS.md no-sunk-cost doctrine). Our ledger detects staleness only by elapsed-time sweeps (find-orphaned-ideas, stale-plan hook); items have no per-item patience or reactivation condition. Cheapest landing: optional patience/wake-up fields in intake/park events plus surfacing in the orphan detector.
title: Ledger items carry patience budgets and wake-up criteria, not silent staleness

summary: Third member of the judge-validity battery (fifth sweep): cross-family judge control — validate judge instruments against a DIFFERENT model family to catch self-preference (~/Projects/content/reader_system/_external_consult.md). Leakage gate tests recall-vs-prediction; fake-yes probes test load-bearing verdicts; cross-family control tests self-preference. All three belong in any toolkit judge-validity convention.

Corpus completeness pass adds the strongest concrete instance: the three-tier reader stack (consolidation/107) — plan-read (may see contracts), artifact-read (final output only, BEFORE intent reveal), diagnostic-read (intent-vs-delivery after). Live failure it fixed: a reader agent validating planning scaffolding instead of final pages. Toolkit translation: review lanes that see the plan/spec are blueprint validators and must not double as proof validators; artifact review goes in cold.

Upstream sibling found in the corpus (consolidation/90): an idea-parking taxonomy with status labels (parked/branch_seed/candidate_mechanic/promoted/rejected) and explicit PROMOTION QUESTIONS — prevents both chat-loss and silent promotion into canon. Pairs with ledger-patience-wakeup: parking discipline = status + promotion questions + wake-up criteria.

lesson_body: The content-pipeline harvest's 'deliberately not imported' list contained a mis-triage (the corpus-ingest browser extension — filed as corpus-specific infrastructure by sweep two, actually the acquisition front-end of the entire reader-research evidence base) that survived four subsequent sweeps and a dryness declaration because every later pass treated prior exclusions as settled. Rule: a completeness pass must re-audit the exclusion list with fresh eyes, not just fill coverage gaps; an item used as an input dependency by harvested operators can never be 'corpus-specific'. The operator caught it, again — the sixth human-pointer find of the session.
lesson_title: Exclusion lists are harvest judgments too — audit them, not just coverage

summary: Operator root-cause diagnosis of the browser-extension miss: the failure was ontological, not procedural — 'idea' was implicitly classified as written-down thought, so working code/utility with no doctrine doc arguing for it was never assessed as an idea at all. Corrected classification: an executable artifact is an idea in its most-validated form. The declared-axes list gains a mandatory axis: utility inventory (tools/ dirs, servers, extensions, CLIs, VENDORED packages — vendoring an external tool is itself an idea: the adoption). Immediate validation: one ls under the corrected lens found three uncarded capabilities (SelfCheckGPT, ViStoryBench, artifact_transfer_pipeline) the same day text-harvest was declared dry. Dryness declarations are scoped to the ontology that produced them.

Operator doctrine (2026-06-12): in an engineering project most solidified ideas live in code, which also shows them APPLIED (call sites) and COMPOSED (imports, call graphs, shared data shapes) — composition edges with execution proof, vs the ledger's hand-authored composes_with guesses. Generalizes ADR 0033's embodied_by from decisions to all ideas: code is the idea population; cards/ledger become the provenance-and-curation layer carrying what code cannot (the why, rejected alternatives, trust states). Implications: harvest reads call graphs as composition evidence; idea records should link their application sites; architecture evolution starts from observed composition, not declared composition. Corollary already validated: the doc-centric ontology systematically inverted evidence ranking (best-documented = most speculative, least-documented = most validated).
title: Code is the primary idea-carrier; prose is the index layer

summary: Operator direction: matching what type of idea applies where cannot live in context — 96 operator cards in content-pipeline, 170+ ledger records here, and the only mechanisms are full-index context loads or grep. Shape: embeddings over ledger summaries, pattern/operator cards, and code symbols (signatures, docstrings), queried by current file or task, returning top-k idea slugs with application sites. Constraint: stdlib-preferred posture suggests sqlite plus embedding cache plus cosine similarity rather than a vector-DB dependency; the embedding call is the one external touch (provider routing per canonical patterns). Consumers: /query-patterns, /which-skill, harvest dedup (sweeps re-finding captured ideas), and the composition-evolution loop of code-as-primary-idea-carrier.
title: Semantic retrieval layer for idea-to-location matching

summary: Operator experiment (2026-06-12): the same corpus comparison run with Haiku instead of Fable scored 5/9 re-finds (it did not diff against the index) but surfaced two real cards and one refinement six large-model sweeps missed — including elevating _VALUE_REGISTER.md from 'project bookkeeping' (the large-model scout's disposition) to a curation practice. Model diversity is lens diversity: cross-family judge control applies to HARVESTING, not just judging — different model families have different salience, so a cheap-model pass over already-swept ground is a low-cost diversity lens, best run WITH an index-diff instruction to cut the re-find tax. Composes with the perspective-diverse-verify doctrine and llm-judge-leakage-gate.

Corpus-proven exemplar found for this skill's design: ~/Projects/comic/consolidation/_VALUE_REGISTER.md — a live alive/inert/dead register over captured knowledge ('inert gold' = true but unwired, queued for wiring). The alive/inert/dead vocabulary and register-artifact shape are directly liftable; carded as content-pipeline operator 97.

The corpus keeps CLAUDE_LEARNINGS.md / CODEX_LEARNINGS.md / GEMINI_LEARNINGS.md at root — durable per-tool findings (distinct failure modes, flag quirks) separate from shared doctrine. This ecosystem has cross-tool RULES (CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .augment mirrors) and shared lesson surfaces, but no per-tool distilled-findings file; tool-specific lessons either get genericized or lost. Flagged independently by two comparison models. Cheapest landing: a documented per-tool section or file convention in the task-diary tier, mirrored per cross-tool governance.
title: Per-tool learning logs beside the shared capture surfaces

summary: Operator's multi-model comparison panel (Haiku, Sonnet, Opus, GPT 5.5 over the same corpora) closes the loop on the model-diversity note: (1) salience really is family-specific — Sonnet surfaced doc-architecture patterns, Opus surfaced discipline sharpenings plus honesty corrections, GPT 5.5 surfaced the meta-state; (2) only the model given an explicit index-diff produced a low-re-find report (GPT 5.5 cited the card index; Sonnet re-found 7/13); (3) CONVERGENCE across independent family lenses is a prioritization signal — all lenses agreed on agent bus, per-tool learning logs, value-register curation, and eval-harness operationalization, which is therefore the wiring shortlist. Panel-of-families with index-diff = the mature form of the post-dryness check.

adoption_evidence: W-F CLOSURE: both done-criterion halves now exist — harvest output (content-pipeline ai-docs/harvest/ + ai-docs/operators/README.md, 101 cards across seven passes) AND first recorded code adoption in the new project (content-pipeline commit 1562961: pipeline/runs.py adopted from corpus card 18 with adoption event + in-flight transition on run-manifests, 9 characterization tests green). The composition ledger mechanism is live end-to-end: card -> copy -> adoption event -> tests.

lesson_body: Rule: a harvest is not dry when the harvester says so; it is dry when an independent fresh-context agent diffing source corpus against destination index returns nothing new — and the sweeps should be model-diverse, because each family surfaced different real misses (six external sweeps across Fable/Haiku/Sonnet/Opus/GPT each found genuine gaps after self-declared dryness). Why: dryness declarations are scoped to the ontology and axes the harvester searched under; misses cluster exactly where the ontology was wrong (code-as-utility, artifact modality), which the harvester cannot see from inside. How to apply: treat external gap sweeps as the dryness instrument, budget for 2+ of them in any harvest plan, and re-scope the declared axes whenever a sweep finds a category (not just an item) that was missed.
lesson_title: Independent gap sweeps are the only dryness test that worked

lesson_body: Rule: when a track's closure criterion is one concrete artifact away (here: a single code adoption after 101 cards across seven harvest passes), build that artifact before accepting another capture pass. Why: capture passes are self-justifying — each sweep finds something, so the loop never terminates on its own; the rebuild sat unbuilt until the operator poked ('what is the point of a clean room rebuild that is not built?'), which is the same wins-remembering-loses-acting failure the Consistency session was convened to fix, recurring inside its own remedy. How to apply: when scoping any harvest/capture effort, schedule the first build/adoption step BEFORE the completeness passes, not after; completeness work can resume once the mechanism is proven end-to-end.
lesson_title: Capture self-perpetuates; build when closure is one artifact away

lesson_body: Rule: the goal artifact shape (W-E) should include a 'value flows' section — each flow named with input, output, the value created, and a status (LIVE / TO ASSEMBLE / PARTIAL) — alongside identity, target value function, floors, veto set, and convergence check. Why: content-pipeline's goals.md was the first real instantiation, and the question that exposed its gap was 'we haven't really tested the pipeline or described its value flows' — identity and floors could not answer whether the project delivers value; flow statuses could, and the LIVE marker had to be earned by an actual run (run-0001), which makes the section a convergence instrument rather than prose. How to apply: when the /goal skill or Track A's goals projection section gets designed, make value-flows a required section and make LIVE require a pointer to a run/artifact.
lesson_title: First real goal artifact converged on a value-flows section

lesson_body: Rule: after every commit, verify it landed (git log -1) — piping git commit through tail/head swallows the non-zero exit and pre-commit output, and this silently lost two commits in one session; and never git add -A in a repo where the user or other agents also write files — it swept a user-owned audit file into a commit twice. Why: both are method slips invisible at the moment of the mistake and only discovered downstream; they cluster in shell idioms (same session also hit zsh word-splitting and conditional-flag-expansion bugs three times). How to apply: commit then check git log; stage explicitly by path; in zsh, never rely on unquoted parameter expansion to produce multiple words.
lesson_title: Commit pipelines mask hook failures; stage by path in shared repos

hypothesis: The seven-pass methodology generalizes beyond this one rebuild; encoding it as a skill prevents re-deriving the ontology corrections (code-as-idea, utility-inventory, gap-sweep dryness) that cost six external sweeps to learn this time.
summary: The content-pipeline rebuild forged a complete, repeatable harvest methodology over seven passes that no current skill owns: declared harvest axes (production, measurement-epistemics, agent-runtime, economics, artifact-modality, utility-inventory), scout fan-out with verbatim report persistence under ai-docs/harvest/, operator cards with states (proven/bounded/unbuilt/retracted), provenance paths and composes-with edges, dead-end autopsies, a deliberately-not-imported list with mandatory re-audit, ontology-scoped dryness declarations tested by independent cross-family gap sweeps, and code copied only via card plus a recorded ledger adoption event. Distinct from /extract-existing-ideas (bulk ledger import from own filesystem) and harvest-learnings-skill (host-project learnings into portable standards): this one targets a predecessor-project corpus feeding a clean-room rebuild. Success looks like a /harvest-corpus skill whose first re-run on a new corpus needs zero methodology re-derivation.
title: Promote the corpus-harvest methodology to a standing skill

hypothesis: A reconstruction pass at card/summary write time catches the distortion class of capture failure that six omission-oriented gap sweeps structurally missed.
summary: Summaries (pyramid outputs, operator cards, plans, compaction notes, condensed rule mirrors) are one-way lossy compressions with no test. Add the backward pass: a blind agent reconstructs the load-bearing details from the summary alone, and the diff against the source classifies into lost-detail-to-promote, deliberately-dropped-to-declare, or hallucination-inviting-phrasing-to-hedge. The detail criterion is decision-equivalence: a summary is detailed enough when reconstruction errors stop changing downstream decisions. Complements gap sweeps: sweeps catch omission (never captured), reconstruction catches distortion (captured wrong) — card 18 overstating make_manifest was a distortion no sweep could see, caught only by the adoption rule forcing a source read. Cheap standing mechanism: every summarizing agent also emits a residue section (details seen but excluded, with pointers).
title: Round-trip reconstruction test for summaries and capture artifacts

hypothesis: A follow-up to the original summarizer catches implementation-vs-source mismatches cheaper than a fresh reviewer re-reading the source, because the oracle already paid the reading cost.
summary: The agent that summarized a corpus holds the richest source context; route post-implementation questions back to it ('did my implementation match what you actually saw? what did I miss?') instead of only to fresh reviewers. Within a session this is buildable today via agent continuation (SendMessage to a completed sub-agent). Across sessions, the persisted equivalents are the agent transcript and a mandatory residue file per summary. This is the diagnostic-read tier (intent-vs-delivery comparison after the fact) applied to capture fidelity. Deliberately paired with fresh-context gap sweeps, not a replacement: retained-context oracles catch fidelity loss, fresh-context sweeps catch the ontology blindness the oracle shares with its past self.
title: Resumable summarizer agents as post-implementation fidelity oracles

hypothesis: The floor-once/fan-out shape preserves the serial flow's correctness while removing its dominant cost (re-establishing consistency per idea-application).
summary: Original ES usage was slow because refactoring serialized: one idea extracted and applied at a time, with the test/consistency floor effectively re-established per step. Invert it: persist the target architecture (Shape B plus drift metric, per target-architecture-artifact), build the characterization-test floor and structural ratchet ONCE, then fan out worktree-isolated agents each applying one idea to one stable-id partition (ADR 0036 batch sweep machinery), with floor+ratchet+drift as the per-batch acceptance gate and dependency-ordered merges. The accuracy guarantee is the same one tests gave the serial flow, paid once instead of N times. Success looks like a measured many-batch transformation where the ratchet never regresses and wall-clock scales with the slowest batch, not the batch count. Needs a design pass before any pilot.
title: Batched A-to-B codebase transformation over a one-time test floor

hypothesis: On an idea-dense file with known ground truth (gpt55pro-response-1.md, 10 eventual cards), N Haiku lens-passes plus deterministic merge beat one underspecified strong-model pass on recall and on reconstruction fidelity per dollar.
summary: Summarization/extraction has no intrinsic goal; an unqualified pass substitutes the model's own salience prior as the loss function, and a file carrying six ideas read under one goal yields only the ones matching the active frame. Decompose instead: N passes, each a cheap model with ONE declared lens/goal, merged deterministically (shard-and-merge, controlled-vocab aggregation) — possibly plus one integrative pass for cross-idea interactions. Direct prior evidence: the comic corpus's Multi-Pass Reader Pipeline (content-pipeline card 74) — five focused cheap-model passes plus a reducer beat single-shot strong-model extraction; dual-lens (62) and the seven-role flow battery (88) are the same one-goal-per-pass shape on the evaluation side. Known risk: omission moves up a level from attention to lens-roster design — fresh-context gap sweeps remain the roster-blindness check. Also implies capture artifacts should declare their consumer (summary-for-adopters differs from summary-for-sweeps), since success is decision-equivalence for a named consumer.
title: Lens-decomposed extraction: N single-goal cheap passes beat one underspecified strong pass

summary: Pilot run complete (content-pipeline run-0003, 10-card sample): CALIBRATION PASSED — the known card-18 distortion was re-found unprimed with file:line evidence. Beyond calibration: 7 new distortions incl. a false evidence count (19), a wrong mechanism story (62 — lenses agreed, not disagreed), a half-false proven claim (60), and a missing protocol substrate (88) that had already propagated into run-0002. 9/10 cards amended. Distortion taxonomy banked in run-0003/synthesis.md: single-origin compression, evidence inflation, mechanism narrativization, roster truncation, parallel-phrasing inflation. Cost ~180k sub-agent tokens per 10 cards.

First experiment (content-pipeline run-0004, operator-requested variant): SELF-DERIVED lenses — Haiku writes its own inventory of the file's threads, then extracts lens-by-lens — scored 10/10 recall vs ground-truth cards 46-55, vs ~7.5/10 for a direct underspecified Haiku pass on the same file. Control's misses were exactly the list-shaped material (ritual catalog, 9-element packet, 8-beat turn grammar) a salience prior compresses away. Key refinement: the inventory is a coverage contract the model writes for itself, dissolving the roster-blindness objection — no human lens roster needed. +40% tokens for the win. DIRECTIONAL (n=1, well-structured file, same-family scorer); replicate on a messier doc before banking.

hypothesis: Retrofitting artifact-truth gates and write-site frame re-activation measurably improves skill execution fidelity, testable via the skill-runtime-adherence-harness on before/after skill versions.
summary: Generalization of the survey-then-extract result (run-0004) to skill design: an LLM executes a skill correctly only when it holds the right goal, frame, and workflow AT THE MOMENT OF ACTING, and prose presence in context is not possession — proven by the track-idea Stage 3 specimen (mandated verification step skipped ~25/25 times with SKILL.md in context). Pattern elements, from the /scope-feature calibration review (reports/skill-frame-review/scope-feature.md): (1) artifact-truth gates — test the deliverable's success property, not its existence/format; (2) frame re-activation at the write site — the gate question embedded in the writing-stage template, not only in core beliefs 200 lines up; (3) phase-0 conversation survey for context-rich invocations; (4) load-bearing-or-delete rule for verification stages — outputs nothing consumes will be skipped; (5) un-fakeable acknowledgments for read-X-end-to-end instructions (name the binding priors). Dogfooded skills already got survey-before-work right (Stage 1 priors, background Explore); this is the next layer.
title: Skills must activate the frame at the point of work, not just the preamble

summary: First quantified in-the-wild adherence datum (2026-06-12 session): /track-idea Stage 3 (show-after-append + <=8-line report) was executed 0 of ~25 times in one session segment DESPITE the full SKILL.md being present in context. Mechanism: the stage's output feeds nothing downstream, so execution momentum deletes it — adherence failure concentrates in non-load-bearing stages, not in core mechanics (Stage 2's helper call was 25/25). Design implication for the harness: check stage-level execution against the skill's mandated pipeline, and weight stages by load-bearingness; the cheap structural fix (make outputs consumed, or delete the stage) may beat enforcement. Calibration review at reports/skill-frame-review/scope-feature.md.

Three fresh-agent reviews (which-shape, diagnose, refactor-subsystem; reports/skill-frame-review/) confirm the pattern is SYSTEMIC: every skill has a sound skeleton whose load-bearing property goes untested at the decisive moment — scope contract unverified, root-cause confirmation undefined (evidence_gate.py checks file existence only), router script authority unframed (live probes: alphabetical fallback dressed as recommendation; negation-blind scoring), decomposition mode pins structure not behavior. Load-bearing rule replicated: diagnose's DIAG-prefix (consumed) executes; refactor's ownership scan (unconsumed) will skip. NEW pattern elements from the wave: referenced-content existence (SKILL.md promises recipes in knowledge/ that are absent — verified: zero archaeology hits, partial cleanliness commands with a hardcoded host path); frame-resume protocol for multi-session skills; telemetry must not default to success (which-shape logs useful before outcome known). Common verdict: none blind-trustable; all fixes small and local; refactor standard mode closest to trustable because characterization tests are the one artifact-truth gate in the ecosystem.

Concrete failure case supplied by the refactor-subsystem frame review (F7): the skill plans for multi-session execution but has no frame-resume protocol, so its within-session re-activation devices (approval tokens, phase gates) all evaporate exactly at the session boundary where the riskiest phase most likely begins. STATE.json + resume is the fix shape this slug already proposes; the frame review adds the requirement that resume must rehydrate the FRAME (active gates, behaviors-to-preserve, current phase contract), not just the position.

Two mechanizable detectors fall out of the frame-review wave, both cheap greps suited to this gate: (1) referenced-content existence — flag SKILL.md pointers ('see knowledge/ for X', named files, named scripts) whose target content is absent (refactor-subsystem ships this defect in its safety net today); (2) load-bearing audit — flag mandated stage outputs that no later stage, gate, or reply contract consumes (predicts skips at ~100%: track-idea Stage 3 evidence). Also: registry/doc drift check (which-shape SKILL.md lists two fewer shapes than shapes.yml).

Operator refinement (declared-verdict principle): RL evidence says models perform better when they know up front how success will be judged — so an artifact-truth gate delivers only half its value as an end-stage filter; the skill/brief must DECLARE it in the instructions ('your output will be tested by X') so it becomes the optimization target. Pair with a mandated pre-work planning beat: the agent thinks first about how to approach the task so it measurably passes the declared checks (the success-criteria twin of run-0004's survey-then-extract, which framed the content dimension). Boundary condition: for creative/aliveness work, declared point-targets are Goodhart bait (corpus protect-lens/aliveness doctrine) — declare floors and must-not-change protections there, not targets; most ES work is near-deterministic code, where targets are right. When the check is gameable or needs a lens the actor cannot hold, measurement belongs to a non-correlated, non-context-sharing verifier (role-separated harness) — and the actor should still be told that verifier and its criteria exist. Repair-batch implication: every P0/P1 fix should both ADD the gate and ANNOUNCE it at the top of the skill text.

hypothesis: Codified, a skill repair needs zero methodology re-derivation, and the independent verifier's finding-by-finding pass becomes the repair's quality metric.
summary: Codify the loop being prototyped live on /refactor-subsystem (2026-06-12): (1) frame-review rubric applied by a fresh agent (reports/skill-frame-review/scope-feature.md defines it) producing cited findings; (2) orchestrator verifies the highest-stakes claims against ground truth before acting (the reviewer's own claims can be distorted-in-compression); (3) change spec with a DECLARED VERDICT block telling the implementer how a fresh verifier will judge the repair; (4) scout agent maps anchors, pointer audits, and source fragments so missing content is assembled, never invented (gaps become explicit host-adapter slots); (5) implementer applies smallest responsible edits; (6) fresh non-context-sharing verifier re-runs the rubric finding-by-finding and checks no new defects of the same classes. Exemplar corpus: .claude/tasks/refactor-subsystem-repair/* and reports/skill-frame-review/*. Division of labor vs /plan-skill: plan-skill gates NEW/revised skill designs; repair-skill is the evidence-driven loop for EXISTING skills, and its output can route through plan-skill's gate.
title: /repair-skill: the evidence-driven skill-repair loop as a standing skill

summary: Operator direction: /plan-skill is the priority application target for this pattern — generative leverage, since every skill passing the intake gate inherits the standard at birth instead of needing repair later. Concretely plan-skill's checklist should gain: a declared-verdict preamble requirement (the new skill states up front how its output will be judged), artifact-truth gates for the skill's deliverable (test the property, not existence), a load-bearing audit (every mandated stage output names its consumer or gets cut), a referenced-content existence check (no pointers to recipes that don't exist), and a frame-resume section for any skill that plans multi-session execution. The in-flight refactor-subsystem repair is the evidence base; /repair-skill (intaken separately) is the sibling loop for existing skills.

Field datum (2026-06-12, content-pipeline corpora): after SIX harvest sweeps, a 101-card index, and an explicit 'text-harvest declared dry' declaration, a fresh two-agent independent read still surfaced 3 genuine uncarded gaps (an entire built style-development system in comic/artist/, a filesystem-trigger orchestrator tools/auto_agent_watcher.py, two uncarded evaluation harnesses in story_sim/) plus 2 mis-dispositions (stale add_lettering deferral; built-vs-unbuilt carding asymmetry between corpora). Dryness declared within one method/reader lineage is not corpus dryness.

lesson_body: Convergence within one extraction method (same reader lineage, same lens set, shared context) measures the method's fixed point, not the corpus's residue. The harvest doctrine's 'declared dry' state needs an exit gate run by fresh, non-context-sharing readers whose findings are diffed against the index - the omission-side sibling of the reconstruction test (distortion side). The recurring miss-shape is modality-skew: text harvest goes dry while executable/built artifacts (tool scripts, style systems, harness files) stay invisible, exactly the 'executable artifact is an idea in its most-validated form' class. Apply: never close a harvest on within-method convergence; close on a clean independent diff, and route one sweep per modality (text, scripts, built systems) before declaring dry.
lesson_title: Dry declarations are method-relative; the dryness gate must be a non-correlated fresh-reader diff

summary: Comparative datum from Hermes's self-improvement architecture: a per-turn background fork (restricted to memory/skill tools only) silently writes bounded memory (~3.6k chars total, forced consolidation) and creates/patches skills on triggers like error-recovery or user-correction; an inactivity curator consolidates/archives stale skills; values live in an immutable SOUL.md layer the loop cannot edit. Human approval staging exists but is OFF by default - silent self-editing is the documented norm. Public critique that fits: every loop-generated update needs a replay case attached (what failed, what changed, what future run should now pass), else the system learns anecdotes, not behavior. Our repair loop already has that shape (frame-review finding -> change-spec with declared verdict -> independent verifier -> lift probe at the defect site); /repair-skill should make the replay case a REQUIRED output per change, and keep the values/veto layer (operator review, immutable doctrine) outside the loop's write surface.

Full validation cycle complete on the /refactor-subsystem exemplar. (1) Lift grid: every probe site with headroom moved to its top score, zero regressions; largest single move at the weakest tier on the absent-content site (Haiku P1 FABRICATED -> CORRECT-FROM-TEXT). (2) Real-host dogfood (Phase 0-1 on host-a pre-cleanup core/tasks.py, 4782 LOC, hostile clone conditions): artifact gate PASSED but text verdict NO - 11 frictions, 3 forcing (unexecutable scout dispatch via read-only agent type, chunker-orphan conflation, no absent-convention-docs fallback). All 10 text frictions fixed same-day in round 2 (dogfood-fixes.md); F10 residual (inventory-check counts only @shared_task symbols, plain helpers invisible to the spec-reality gate) deferred as a script change. The dogfood log doubles as the replay case the meta-loop doctrine requires.

lesson_body: A skill repair has three failure surfaces and each needs its own instrument: internal consistency (independent verifier - pointers resolve, counts match, nothing invented), behavior at known defect sites (A/B probes with criteria locked before results), and executability against a host the skill was not written on (dogfood under hostile-but-realistic conditions: missing docs, no venv, read-only agent types, detached HEAD). The refactor-subsystem exemplar passed the first two and failed the third with 3 high-severity frictions - the unexecutable-against-reality class is invisible to both other instruments by construction. Apply: /repair-skill closes only after a real-host dogfood, and the dogfood log (friction -> fix -> scenario-that-should-now-pass) is the required replay case per change.
lesson_title: Verifier PASS plus probe lift does not imply executability; real-host dogfood is the third required instrument

summary: Batch repair #2 complete (diagnose, which-shape, scope-feature) using the full validated loop, ~3 hours wall-clock with parallel sub-agents. All three independent verifiers PASS (10/10, 8/8, 7/7 items; no-invention audits clean). Scaled lift grid (haiku-only, headline defect site per skill): diagnose PARTIAL-BAR->FULL-BAR, scope-feature FORMAT-ONLY->FULL-BAR, which-shape HEDGED->GATED; which-shape's probe-B misroute additionally fixed at the scorer level (concept-rename now beats negated-typo direct-change). Scout stage again earned its place: found the F8 unexecutable-dispatch class in scope-feature (same defect, different skill - the class recurs) and a second drifted in-code shape table in which-shape. Residuals ledgered: which-shape cue-constant narrowing (trimmed boost tokens like crash now score low, caught by the new C1 gate but a routing-quality tradeoff; proper fix is Path A data-driven boosts in shapes.yml), evidence_gate.py content-level checks (shared script, needs own tested change), scope-feature Stage 4.5 iteration cap.

lesson_body: In the diagnose lift probe, the pre-repair executor demanded hypothesis elimination - correct behavior - while attributing the mandate to skill text that does not contain it ('the skill prohibits declaring root cause until all hypotheses are tested' - no such sentence existed). The executor's training prior happened to point the right way, so fabrication presented as compliance. Two consequences: (1) old-condition scores are inflated at any site where the model's prior overlaps the repair content, so measured lift is a LOWER bound there; (2) the repair's real value at such sites is grounding, not behavior change - the post-repair executor cites the actual mandate, which survives executors whose priors point elsewhere and removes the brittleness of prior-dependent compliance. Apply: when judging A/B probes, score the GROUNDING (does the cited mandate exist?) alongside the behavior; a right answer with an invented citation is a latent failure, not a pass.
lesson_title: Old-condition probes can score compliant on fabricated grounding; probe grids underestimate lift where executor priors overlap repair content

summary: Skill now exists: .claude/skills/repair-skill/ (SKILL.md + knowledge/frame-review-rubric.md), authored through /plan-skill's intake process (brief, adversarial review, validation plan, evidence gate 4/4 under reports/plan-skill/scan-20260612-123750). Distilled FROM the two validated campaign runs rather than ahead of them. plan-skill simultaneously retrofitted with five execution-learned rules: declared verdict, load-bearing-or-delete + un-fakeable acknowledgments, executable-as-written contracts (agent types/placeholders/absence fallbacks), real-host dogfood as the binding case for execution-heavy skills, and the repair-loop gate for material revisions. Matcher gap found during build gates and ledgered separately: prompts containing a target skill's name (repair the /diagnose skill) poison which-skill's job inference - same lexical-prior class as the which-shape repair.

hypothesis: A fixture-per-defect-class corpus (not per-skill) with golden expected outcomes makes skill validation cheap enough to run on every material revision, closing the CI-for-skills gap.
summary: Skills need test substrates the way code needs test suites: known-messy inputs that exhibit the defect classes each skill handles, so repairs and new behaviors can be validated against ground truth instead of author-imagined scenarios. Three sourcing strategies with different fidelity/shippability tradeoffs: frozen real states (private host pre-cleanup commits - highest fidelity, not shippable), distilled synthetic fixtures (minimal repo slices exhibiting one smell - shippable, risk probe-overfitting), and defect injection into clean code (scalable, measurable precision/recall for detector skills). New behaviors need new samples: when a dogfood or incident surfaces a new friction class, its scenario joins the corpus as a replay case - the corpus grows by accretion from real failures, not upfront design.
title: Curated fixture corpus for validating and regression-testing skills

summary: Sibling matcher gap (which-skill, found during repair-skill build gates): a prompt containing a target skill's name - 'repair the /diagnose skill' - poisons match.py's job inference (the /diagnose token reads as job=diagnose, tier=maintenance), so cross-cutting/meta skills structurally cannot surface for it. Same lexical-prior-without-override-license class as the repaired which-shape F2. Candidate fixes when v2 lands: strip /skill-name tokens before inference, or treat them as routing TARGETS not cues.

hypothesis: Encoded as a skill (or folded into map-subsystem/corpus-harvest), each layer becomes checkable by the reconstruction test (downward fidelity) and the dual-compression rule generalizes the non-correlated-instruments doctrine to corpus mapping.
summary: Rediscovered in host-a's task diary (project-shape-audit-recursive.md, 2026-05-19) after the operator recalled using a summary-of-summary structure for subsystem mapping and folder organization. Method: Layer A per-doc 1-2-sentence summaries (intent/key-claim/stance) -> Layer B cluster summaries -> Layer C single-paragraph meta-summary derived ONLY from Layer B -> cross-layer findings. Paired with a sibling concept-frequency audit under an explicit robustness rule: findings that survive two independent compression strategies are robust; disagreements are themselves signal (said-often-but-not-load-bearing vs load-bearing-but-said-rarely). Produced a durable artifact: host-a's .claude/docs/_map.md topical map citing the Layer B clusters. Never promoted into the engineering-skills ecosystem - no skill encodes it.

summary: Found by the forgotten-artifact sweep in host-a's .engineering/research/role-agents/ (README, operating-model, role-contract/handoff/takeover templates, pilot protocol, outcome log). Working hypothesis: AI-assisted implementation drops inspection/drafting/review cost enough to unlock addressable QA work, but only with clear jurisdiction, memory, handoff rules, and stop conditions. Defines an AI-addressability gate (bounded, repeatable, reviewable, verifiable) and a role contract shape (role_id, jurisdiction, decision_rights, memory_sources, escalation_path, handoff_shape, stop_condition). Deliberately parked separate from the skill system to avoid persona drift, memory rot, automation churn. Composes with the meta-loop taxonomy discussion (intake/refine/ship/review agent chains).
